# `media/codecs/LossyCodec.js`

> **Source:** `engine/media/codecs/LossyCodec.js`

PRV lossy v1: integer Walsh-Hadamard 8x8 transform, scalar quantization, sparse coefficient runs, and bounded motion prediction from RECONSTRUCTED planes. This is an authored format, not H.264, MPEG, AV1, or the native WebCodecs API.
